tools.name: sku_list_products
tools.description: List products and SKUs with type, archived flag and default supplier. Good first call to find a SKU id. Requires products:read. GET /api/v2/products.

tools.name: sku_get_product
tools.description: Get one product with its SKU, attributes and defaults. Requires products:read. GET /api/v2/products/{product}.

tools.name: sku_get_product_inventory
tools.description: Get stock levels for one product across warehouses (on hand, allocated, available). Requires inventory:read. GET /api/v2/products/{product}/inventory.

tools.name: sku_list_stock_by_location
tools.description: List stock quantities per warehouse location. Use it to find low or empty locations. Requires inventory:read. GET /api/v2/inventory/location-quantities.

tools.name: sku_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses with their ids and status. Requires warehouses:read. GET /api/v2/warehouses.

tools.name: sku_list_sales_orders
tools.description: List sales orders for the list view, with ship-by and deliver-by dates and hold-until dates. Requires orders:read. GET /api/sales-orders/list.

tools.name: sku_get_sales_order
tools.description: Get one sales order with its status, customer and totals. Requires orders:read. GET /api/v2/sales-orders/{salesOrder}.

tools.name: sku_get_sales_order_line_items
tools.description: List the line items of one sales order. Requires orders:read. GET /api/v2/sales-orders/{salesOrder}/line-items.

tools.name: sku_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders with status, supplier, destination warehouse and dates. Requires purchase-orders:read. GET /api/purchase-orders/list.

tools.name: sku_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order with its status, supplier, totals and dates. Requires purchase-orders:read. GET /api/purchase-orders/{purchase_order}.

tools.name: sku_get_purchase_order_lines
tools.description: List the lines of one purchase order (product, quantity, unit cost). Requires purchase-orders:read. GET /api/purchase-orders/{purchase_order}/lines.

tools.name: sku_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers with their ids, contacts and archived flag. Requires suppliers:read. GET /api/v2/suppliers.

tools.name: sku_get_supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier with its contact and terms. Requires suppliers:read. GET /api/v2/suppliers/{supplier}.

tools.name: sku_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with their ids and contact details. Requires customers:read. GET /api/v2/customers.

tools.name: sku_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer with its contact details and account settings. Requires customers:read. GET /api/v2/customers/{customer}.
